# lean-pkg help

help topics (exit-codes, environment, formatting) or a command's --help.

## Usage

```text
lean-pkg help [common flags] [TOPIC|COMMAND ...]
```

`[common flags]`: `--json`, `--commit`, `--push`, `--no-commit`, also accepted before the command name; see the [CLI overview](../cli.md).

Without an argument: the commands and help topics. With a topic (exit-codes, environment, formatting): that topic. With a command (`help status`, `help index add`): exactly its --help. Reads no registry.

## Arguments and flags

| Argument or flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `TOPIC\|COMMAND` |   |

## Details

| Form | What it does | Key flags |
|---|---|---|
| `help [TOPIC\|COMMAND ...]` | help topics in the manner of `gh help`: no argument lists the commands and topics; `exit-codes`, `environment` and `formatting` print that topic; a command (`help status`, `help index add`) prints exactly its `--help` (`help comparator config` and `help comparator host-check` print `comparator --help`, which covers them); an unknown topic or command is a usage error (exit 2) naming the topics. Reads no registry, so it works without one and under `--registry-snapshot`. `--json`: `{"ok": true, "text", "topic"\|"command"\|"topics" and "commands"}`, and `variables` [{name, section, meaning, default}] for `environment` | `[TOPIC\|COMMAND ...]` |

## Exit codes

0 success (dry runs and no-ops included), 1 refused or failed, 2 usage error; see [Exit codes](../cli.md#exit-codes).

## Examples

List the commands and the help topics.

```bash
lean-pkg help
```

Print the exit codes and what exit 1 means for each command that answers yes or no.

```bash
lean-pkg help exit-codes
```

Print exactly the text of `lean-pkg gate --help`.

```bash
lean-pkg help gate
```
